summary: Frontend-only visual-accessibility verification of Compass 3.0 Visible Interpretation highlighting on live student preview (/?preview=writing). Ran the full flow (assignment → writing → coaching card in ~38s) with the canonical Fixed Mindset paragraph and validated all 7 acceptance criteria via computed styles + screenshot. All PASS.

acceptance_results.A1_thesis_solid_label: PASS — data-testid='vi-thesis-region' present, class 'vi-thesis-region', outline-style='solid', outline-color=rgb(68,64,60), outline-width=1px, ::before content='"THESIS"', text = "The fixed mindset consists of the belief that one's abilities are fixed and cannot change."
acceptance_results.A2_elab_dashed_label: PASS — data-testid='vi-elab-region' present, class 'vi-elab-region', outline-style='dashed', outline-color=rgb(68,64,60), ::before content='"ELABORATION"', text starts "Fixed and unchanging abilities are those that can be said to be carved in stone. For example, people…"
acceptance_results.A3_focus_underline_only_local: PASS — 1 vi-focus-underline element with text-decoration-line='underline', class present, nested INSIDE vi-elab-region (insideElab=true, insideThesis=false); underlined text = 'Fixed and unchanging abilities are those that can be said to be carved in stone.'
acceptance_results.A3b_regions_not_underlined: PASS — thesis region textDecorationLine='none'; elab region textDecorationLine='none' (underline reserved for focus span only)
acceptance_results.A4_grayscale_safe: PASS — thesis and elab outline colors are identical neutral rgb(68,64,60); the ONLY distinction is outline-style (solid vs dashed) + text label. Distinguishable in grayscale.
acceptance_results.A5_no_double_meaning: PASS — the sole underlined span sits INSIDE the elaboration outline as a local focus phrase; no region is itself underlined; no passage carries both a region outline AND a region-level underline.
acceptance_results.A6_readable_uncluttered: PASS — at 1920x900 the labels are small caps micro-labels sitting on the top-left of each box; text remains legible; no layout overflow; coaching card renders cleanly below.

critical_code_review_comments: Visual grammar in /app/frontend/src/index.css and PublicPreview.jsx renderInterpretationSegments is clean and correct. Uses outline (not border) to preserve overlay/textarea alignment — good choice.

Both regions share default <mark> yellow background which is inherited from browser UA styles. The distinction remains valid (solid vs dashed outline + labels), but for stricter grayscale/accessibility parity consider explicitly setting a neutral background (or 'background: transparent') on .vi-thesis-region/.vi-elab-region so the region distinction never leans on the yellow tint. Non-blocking; acceptance criteria only require that color not be the *distinguishing* signal, which is satisfied.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral canonical_v2 session via the preview flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visible Interpretation visual grammar (solid THESIS box, dashed ELABORATION box, underline for local focus phrase inside a region) is verified on live preview. Backend flow parity with iteration_2 confirmed (coaching card in ~40s). CSS keys: .vi-thesis-region (outline solid + ::before THESIS), .vi-elab-region (outline dashed + ::before ELABORATION), .vi-focus-underline (text-decoration underline). Both region outlines are rgb(68,64,60). preview-interpretation-mvp diagram remains hidden without ?diagram param.
